summary: TotalEnergies SE filed a Form 6-K disclosing two signed transactions. TotalEnergies agreed to acquire Shell's entire European onshore renewables business, comprising 500 MW of operating/under-construction assets and a 3.5 GW pipeline, for undisclosed consideration, expected to close by end-2026 pending regulatory approvals. Separately, TotalEnergies agreed to sell a 50% stake in a 1.2 GW developed renewables portfolio to a KKR-managed insurance account at an enterprise value of €1.8 billion. TotalEnergies retains a 50% stake and will operate the assets. Watch regulatory approvals and completion timing across both deals.
